# Selected Adaptive Reasoning policy

`policy.js` is copied verbatim from `package/src/policy.js` in the already
distributed public MIT archive `release/dsh/plugins/dsh-adaptive-reasoning-0.2.3.tgz`.
Archive SHA-256: `5c142213e4f7935cf7e8f0ba839e17d274451c689c04637001dd1d89b6da967e`.
Public source: [dsh-adaptive-reasoning](https://github.com/ManoloRemiddi/dsh-adaptive-reasoning),
commit `64a1ef82e3d69f57a69809d530c1b9ed0bc67480`.
Original MIT notice is retained in `LICENSE` and the source header.

The declaration file and Pi adapter are independently authored Augmentor files.
No DSH agent loop, Cordis adapter or telemetry exporter is included.
